## Purpose 
<!--- One sentence to describe the purpose of this PR, refer to any linked issues:
#14 -- this will link to issue 14
Closes #2 -- this will automatically close issue 2 on PR merge
-->
The resolved-gradient variance block is the variance from a Gaussian subgrid parcel displacement with covariance c_g diag(ℓ_h², ℓ_h², ℓ_v²), split into the part along the local θ_li surface and the part across it.

Along the surface the displacement is conditioned on δ·∇θ_li = 0, which gives q′q′ = gᵀDg − (gᵀDn)²/(nᵀDn) with 3D gradients g = ∇q_tot, n = ∇θ_li. This contains the previous horizontal term exactly for parallel horizontal gradients (|∇_h q − r ∇_h θ|² times the cell cap 1/(1 + (sΔx/Δz)²)), is bounded by Cauchy–Schwarz for any stratification, and caps only displacements in the tilt direction.

Across the surface the vertical uniform-box block keeps θ′θ′ and uses the q gradient across the surface for q′q′ and θ′q′, so the two parts are orthogonal and nothing is counted twice. Results are unchanged for a flat θ_li surface.

body: The checkbounds job does not need to run on buildkite, it can easily run in the github actions unit tests which already run with --check-bounds. This PR moves the test out of buildkite and into the unit tests and removes extra check-bounds related overhead. We still test that a sphere simulation is not silently accessing out of bounds memory.
title: Move Checkbounds job into unit tests
